conclusion: A module loaded through importlib.spec_from_file_location must establish the repository and tools import roots explicitly when its sibling manifest is not installed as a package.
decision: Keep the Qwen smoke import-path fix narrow and test it alongside the static 15-contract gate; never promote CUDA, CPU, or NVIDIA execution to AMD success.
invalidated_assumptions: Running the smoke as a script and loading it through an importlib spec use identical sys.path behavior.
A passing static source/shape gate means Qwen AMD inference has executed.
observation: The explicit repository/tools path setup makes the importlib-loaded smoke pass its five static tests; the runtime remains blocked on the detected CUDA/NVIDIA environment and fallback counters remain non-passing.
question_or_symptom: Why did the Qwen smoke need an import-path fix even though direct execution already worked?
